admission_fallback: If no remote-offload queue point certifies, keep prefill local and certify local capacity plus all server decode overflow. Never drop excess generation. Overflow catches up the local journal; offload-only pending is an upper bound where p>0, and p=0 uses local work per overflow refresh capped by full existing-prefix cold-work bound. Full-depth restore bytes are a conservative checkpoint-size reservation, not a claim that an unreplayed checkpoint is current.
arrival_basis: UNMEASURED homogeneous Poisson arrivals, uniform random node assignment; rates from accepted calls/day divided by8h, independent Bernoulli offload thinning. Accepted engine has exchangeable opportunities, not measured timestamps or a queue process.
queue_basis: Per-node M/G/1 Pollaczek-Khinchine mean; sequential node reservation includes read, prefill, checkpoint write and response wire; GPU decode overflow uses accepted equivalent batched work, not a measured vLLM scheduler. Smallest certified queue-budget grid point; no tail-latency guarantee.
read_write_policy: All retained checkpoints off GPU; full server-format copy restored before each offload/overflow, full checkpoint written back after it. Network and checkpoint IO serialized per node conservatively. No implicit GPU cache hits or fresh-prefix rebuild charge.
